test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An omission of duty
solution:
The correct answer is Delinquency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider each option-

 
 
• Surrender*- ***to stop fighting and admit** that you have lost*.*
 
• Delinquency- **criminal behavior committed by juveniles** under the legal age of adulthood..
 
• Deliberation*- ***discussion or thinking about something** in detail
 
• Delineation- the action of describing or marking the edge of something.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to substitute the expression 'An omission of duty' is 'Delinquency'.
 
• Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.
